marketing_description: The AJ MFG Attic Access Door, part number 27233, features a durable construction with a polyester-painted finish and a weather-tight seal. This door is made with a polystyrene and steel door material, an aluminum frame, and polystyrene insulation, providing an R-Value of R6.5. It also includes safety features such as a 1-point mortise locking type and an egress pull cord.
